title: shimr khanjar na chala
body:
Haaye Hussain, Haaye Hussain
Shimr Ne Gardan E Mazloom Pe Khanjar Jo Rakha
Kuchh Qadam Door Se Deti Rahi Zainab Ye Sada
<<MINI>>
Aakhri Baar Bahen Choom Le Bhai Ka Gala
Shimr Khanjar Na Chala
<<DIVIDER>>
Teer Jee Bhar Ke Ise Maar Chuka Hai Lashkar
Barchhiyan Pahlu Me Tooti Hain Sitam Aur Na Kar
Khud Hi Aa Jayegi Kuchh Der Mein Bhai Ko Qaza
<<MINI>>
Shimr Khanjar Na Chala

<<DIVIDER>>
Minnaten Karti Hoon Zalim Teri Aisa Tu Na Kar
Asr Ke Waqt Mere Ghar Me Andhera Tu Na Kar
Shaam Se Pehle Bujhaata Hai Charagh E Zahra

<<DIVIDER>>
Sun Ke Halmin Ki Sada Aayi Hai Rann Me Bachchi
Chal Na Jaaye Kahin Donon Pe Layeen Teri Chhuri
Dekh Bhai Ke Gale Par Hai Sakina Ka Gala
<<MINI>>

<<DIVIDER>>
Dekh Sakta Nahi Tu Jo Nazar Aata Hai Mujhe
Wasta Deti Hoon Tatheer Ki Aayat Ka Tujhe
Haath Amma Ne Hai Shabbir Ki Gardan Pe Rakha
<<MINI>>
Shimr Khanjar Na Chala
Aakhri Baar Bahen Choom Le Bhai Ka Gala
Shimr Khanjar Na Chala
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaat Kar Sajde Mein Akbar Shahe Wala Ka Gala
Shimr Hansta Hua Shabbir Ke Seene Se Utha
Goonjti Rah Gayi Maqtal Mein Ye Zainab Ki Sada
<<MINI>>
Shimr Khanjar Na Chala
